## About

Nixon builds production software across the stack: interfaces, APIs, data and the last mile of shipping. His recent work is focused on AI-powered tools, SaaS systems and products people actually use. He prefers owning the path from architecture to implementation to the next iteration.

## Skills

React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, REST APIs, Bun, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Prisma, Redis, Python, spaCy, RAG, LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenRouter), Claude Code, Cursor, Git, Docker, GitHub Actions, Vercel.

Currently exploring: AI Agents, Multimodal Agents, LLM Observability, Evaluations.

## Experience

- Cluster Protocol — Frontend Developer (Jan 2026 – Apr 2026, Noida, India · Hybrid). Developed responsive, component-driven interfaces with React, built reusable UI, integrated REST APIs and focused on performance and maintainable frontend architecture.
